methods.label: Coordinate dot product
methods.explanation:
The dot product is the sum of the products of corresponding coordinates:
\[
d_1\cdot d_2=1\cdot0+0\cdot1+0\cdot0=0.
\]
Since both direction vectors are nonzero, their zero dot product means the directions of the two lines are perpendicular, and the angle between them is \(90^\circ\). The requested dot product is \(0\).
